headline: Mexico Deepens U.S. Integration via Automotive Industry Strategy
summary: Mexico aims to encourage Chinese automotive industry investments to produce locally and export to the United States, deepening industrial integration.
why: Cross-border manufacturing networks and supply chain corridors dictate regional trade balances and tariff exposures.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Automotive manufacturing integration impacts cross-border trade between Mexico and the US.
